clips.title: The story
paras: Mo'grosh ogres hold Jordan's Ore Shipment in the northeastern hills of Loch Modan. The ore came by caravan from the Wetlands for Bailor Stonehand to refine into an alloy for the smith Jordan Stilwell.

Jordan Stilwell's ore shipment was bound for Bailor Stonehand, a dwarf who would refine it into his special alloy. The caravan carried the ore south through the mountains from the Wetlands into Loch Modan when Mo'grosh ogres ambushed it. The ogres dragged the shipment to their stronghold in the wilderness. The surviving guards perished from their wounds, and Jordan's smithing project waits until the ore is recovered.
